name: 数量を動かして割合を考える
prompt:
Create a polished Japanese success-state ratio exercise component on a 390 × 760 px portrait canvas. Use the native preview as the exact Japanese content, geometry, object positions and visible-state reference. Use the original Duolingo screenshot for source context and color meaning. The separate third reference is the exact Bea illustration asset: preserve that character artwork without redrawing, recoloring, adding texture or changing its crop. Return the component canvas only, with no phone frame, status bar or app chrome.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the page, question bubble, exercise board, rice-bag interiors, cup bodies, success area and controls white #FFFFFF. Remove the pale mint exercise-board background, mint container fills and pale-green success band. Separate areas with fine neutral #E4E4E4 borders and no colored glow, gradients, paper texture or tinted shadows. Use Meiryo and match the native Japanese typography and wrapping.

Match the native layout:
- Heading at x=16/y=8, 358×28, Meiryo Bold 20/28: “ビーを手伝いましょう”.
- Bea’s exact supplied illustration at x=24/y=70, 109×161.
- White question card at x=144/y=90, 230×118, fine neutral border; place the exact two-line copy at x=160/y=116, 198×48, Meiryo Regular 14/24:
米3に対して水1になる
組合せを作りましょう。
- Fine neutral divider at x=16/y=246, 358×1.
- Main ratio board at x=16/y=278, 358×252, white with a subtle neutral outline. Place three 64×70 rice bags at x=48, 158 and 268, y=302. Their interiors are pure white and their outlines are solid forest green #1F6444; no pale fill.
- In the same board, place one 82×58 water cup at x=148/y=430. Its vessel body stays white with a neutral slate #526173 outline. Show the water with a single flat, saturated blue #2786B3 fill inside the cup. This blue is the semantic water content from the source, not a tinted surface. Keep the water fill consistent in both water cups.
- Below the board, keep the draggable pair: one 64×70 white rice bag with a solid forest-green outline at x=112/y=578; one white 82×58 slate-outlined water cup at x=218/y=584 with the same solid blue water fill.
- Keep the success area from y=666 to the bottom pure white, separated by a fine neutral top border. At x=16/y=676, show “よくできました！” in Meiryo Bold 14/24 and forest green #1F6444. Preserve the existing success state.
- Keep the primary button at x=16/y=708, 358×44, flat solid forest green #1F6444 with white Meiryo Regular 14/24 label “次へ進む”. Do not tint the success area.

Preserve all exact Japanese copy, the 3-rice-to-1-water composition, the character, the success message and the next action. Use green only for rice outlines, success text and the primary action; use blue only for the water content, and neutral gray only for the water vessel outlines and separators. All other surfaces remain pure white. Do not add progress, combo, answer feedback, labels, extra objects or decoration. Keep the component compact, legible, high-contrast and faithful to the native geometry.
reviewNotes: White surfaces and no pale tint fills verified. Japanese success-state content is present. Exact Bea artwork was redrawn, so one focused correction remains.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
